'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Morten Iversen DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Morten Iversen]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Morten Iversen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 8.2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Zenith
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
